events.title: DEF CON hacker conference begins
events.summary: The first [DEF CON] opened on June 9, 1993 in Las Vegas — a party for hackers that grew into the world's largest underground security conference.
events.about: Jeff Moss (Dark Tangent) invited phone phreaks and BBS sysops to the Sands Hotel; thirty years later [DEF CON] hosts tens of thousands of researchers, CTF competitors, and vendor booths. Talks on ATM jackpotting, car hacking, and election security start here before they hit mainstream news — the cultural bridge between warez kids and professional red teams.

narrative.whyChosen: [DEF CON] became the annual reunion of hacker culture turned security industry.
narrative.whyImportant: It normalized responsible disclosure and recruited talent into corporate security roles.
narrative.problemSolved: Hackers lacked a legitimate venue to meet, compete, and share research without prosecution.
